name: Physical Disorder on Shanghai Streets: Five Pairwise Questions
description:
Method replication: participants compare pairs of Shanghai street views on the five questions of the paper's Table 1 (which place gives a stronger sense of disordered architecture, commerce, roads, green spaces, infrastructure), with the paper's examples of each kind of disorder shown under the question, 8 pairs per question; the images are not the paper's stimuli (110 re-fetched Baidu street views within Shanghai's Outer Ring Road, 2019–2023).

Original study: Liu, Lu, Song, Qiu & Liu (2025), Computers, Environment and Urban Systems 122, 102348. From 60,007 Baidu street views sampled every 100 m within the Outer Ring Road (2020–2022), 300 were drawn at random for an online survey in which more than 50 respondents aged 20–40, gender-balanced, chose which of two images showed more disorder on one of five aspects. TrueSkill turned the votes into 0–10 scores, machine-learning models predicted them city-wide, and the scores were related to pedestrian volume by age and gender.

Differences from the original study: (1) newly fetched Baidu street views instead of the authors' 300 images, which are not released; (2) every participant answers all five questions with 8 pairs each, whereas the paper does not report how many comparisons each respondent made; (3) gender, age and familiarity with Shanghai are asked first; the prediction model and the pedestrian-volume analysis are not part of the survey.
author: Liu, Lu, Song, Qiu & Liu

elements.title: I agree to take part. My answers are recorded anonymously for research.

elements.name: architectural_disorder
elements.title: Which place has given you a stronger sense of disordered architecture?
elements.description: Examples: Abandoned buildings, damaged or unkempt facades, graffiti, illegal advertisements, illegal or temporary buildings.

elements.name: commercial_disorder
elements.title: Which place has given you a stronger sense of disordered commerce?
elements.description: Examples: Stores with poor signboards or facades, vacant and pending stores.

elements.name: road_disorder
elements.title: Which place has given you a stronger sense of disordered roads?
elements.description: Examples: Broken roads, roads stacked with personal belongings, garbage or litter on the street.

elements.name: greenery_disorder
elements.title: Which place has given you a stronger sense of disordered green spaces?
elements.description: Examples: Green spaces that look messy or poorly maintained.

elements.name: infrastructure_disorder
elements.title: Which place has given you a stronger sense of disordered infrastructure?
elements.description: Examples: Broken infrastructure, neglected wires, malfunctioning streetlights, unmaintained distribution boxes, damaged public interfaces, leftover construction fences.
